title: Unhoused
summary: UNHOUS'ED, participle passive 1. Driven from a house or habitation. 2. adjective Wanting a house; homeless. 3. Having no settled habitation. 4. Destitute of shelter or cover. Cattle in severe weather

inlines.v: UNHOUS'ED, participle passive 1. Driven from a house or habitation. 2. adjective Wanting a house; homeless. 3. Having no settled habitation. 4. Destitute of shelter or cover. Cattle in severe weather should not be left unhoused
